decisions.reason: The startup accelerator is cheap to keep but peripheral to the machinery core, and its one-year home-page presence shows no traction yet, so it stays open with a real risk of being cut.

The CO2-negative bitumen binder is a flagship with highly uncertain but potentially large value and its own page, so keeping this option open while the market's response becomes clearer is justified despite its distance from the core business.
The infectious-waste plant is a partnership-backed flagship that builds on core WASTX technology, keeping it costs little relative to its upside, and its early results do not yet justify abandonment.
The mobile SNOWFLAKE plant fits the decentralized recycling core and complements existing systems as a pretreatment stage, so its option value is high and its incremental cost low.
